'''2008 Maryland State Championship''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG state championship played in [[Cube]] sealed format on Saturday 2 August 2008 at Renaissance Games, Fallston, Maryland, with [[Tim Simon]] as tournament director.<ref name="sf-21815-314888">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=314888#p314888 MD States - Aug 2nd], Aglets (Tim Simon), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (13 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125192451/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t21815.html Internet Archive]</ref> Eight players took part in what Simon called "the first ever cube-format MD states". [[Greg Shaw]] was the top Light Side player and [[Jan Westergard]] the top Dark Side player; both already held byes, so the bye into Day 2 of the [[2008 World Championship|World Championship]] passed to [[Chris Westergard]], who finished the day undefeated.<ref name="sf-21815-320790">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=320790#p320790 MD States - Aug 2nd], Aglets (Tim Simon), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (3 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125192451/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t21815.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Organization ==

Simon announced the event on 13 July 2008: registration from about 10:45 am, drafting from about 11:30 am, at least four games followed by a final between the top Dark Side and top Light Side players, and a $20 entry fee going to prize support, with a prize package from the Players Committee. He would play only if there was an odd number of players.<ref name="sf-21815-314888" />

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Renaissance Games, Fallston, Maryland<ref name="sf-21815-314888" />
* '''Dates:''' 2 August 2008<ref name="sf-21815-314888" />
* '''Time:''' registration from about 10:45 am, drafting from about 11:30 am<ref name="sf-21815-314888" />
* '''Format:''' [[Cube]] sealed; at least four games, then a final between the top Dark Side and top Light Side players<ref name="sf-21815-314888" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $20<ref name="sf-21815-314888" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Tim Simon]]<ref name="sf-21815-314888" />
* '''Day 2 bye:''' [[Chris Westergard]]<ref name="sf-21815-320790" /><ref name="sf-22883-332133">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=332133#p332133 List of People who have Worlds Day Two Auto Bids 2008], simone89 (Cedric Simon), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125194535/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t22883.html Internet Archive]</ref>

Simon's post also gives every game of the day. He wrote that the event heavily favored the Light Side: by the time scum came around in the draft it was too late to build a deck around it, so Light Side players deployed "deploy 2 forfeit 8 guys with insurrection" and outlasted the Dark Side, and Wedge "seemed to dominate wherever he went". Kafer and Shaw came from out of state and put together an extra cube in case it was needed. Simon expected it to be the last non-constructed qualifier in the area for some time.<ref name="sf-21815-320790" />
